svg.title: AUBO nominal DH frames with gripper TCP — editable vector drawing
svg.desc: Zero joint angles; DH frame 0 equals base_link. All visible elements are editable vector paths, lines, polygons and live text. No raster images. Geometry from URDF, exact pi nominal fixed rotations; body is schematic.
